items.title: What Is Barrick Mining (TSX:ABX) Unlocking With Its Nevada Gold Mines Deal?
items.summary: Barrick Mining (TSX:ABX) and Newmont have resolved all outstanding disputes and updated the governance of their Nevada Gold Mines joint venture. Both companies plan to contribute major development assets to Nevada Gold Mines as part of the new agreement. The deal includes Newmont’s consent to Barrick’s planned IPO of its North American gold assets.
